contract: Fluid editorial portfolio: the frame must use the available viewport width at 320, 390, 768, 1024, 1440, and 1920 CSS pixels; text remains readable through local measures, media can reach the far edge, and no horizontal overflow or clipped interactive content is allowed. Direction: name-as-monument. Scope: localized homepage and shared layout components.

accessibility.evidence: Playwright snapshots exposed landmark structure, one h1, localized navigation, skip link, visible theme/menu/chat labels, aria-current, readable controls, and no console errors.

responsive.evidence: Rendered QA covered six viewport classes; the 1024px hero switches to a single full-width composition, the 768px header uses the mobile menu, headings remain visible, and measured horizontal overflow is false at every target.

loading.reason: The audited homepage has no user-facing loading state in the reviewed route.

empty.reason: The audited homepage renders curated portfolio content and has no empty state in the reviewed route.

error.reason: No error state is exposed by the reviewed homepage render.

partial.evidence: The GitHub section remains structurally complete when dynamic repository data is sparse and keeps the page composition intact.

success.evidence: The localized homepage renders its full editorial content, project cases, GitHub proof, CTA, footer, and interactive controls at all target widths.

permission.reason: The reviewed public portfolio route has no permission-gated surface.

renderedEvidence.observation: Smallest supported viewport with readable title, reachable CTA, mobile controls, and no horizontal overflow.
Mobile editorial composition with compact gutters, full-width media, and stable one-column reading flow.
Tablet composition uses the mobile header before navigation labels become cramped and keeps the hero headline intact.
Tablet-wide composition keeps the hero in a readable vertical flow and gives the portrait the full visual width available.
Desktop layout uses the viewport frame with asymmetrical editorial columns and readable local text measures.
Ultrawide layout uses the available frame instead of a centered 90rem shell; the nameplate and portrait reach the lateral composition without clipping.
